title: Ring isomorphisms preserve regular local rings
statement: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative rings and let $e:R\xrightarrow{\sim}S$ be a ring isomorphism. If $R$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], then $S$ is a regular local ring.

source.place: Tag 00KU (definition-regular-local), invariance of the defined property under ring isomorphism; explicit Mathlib theorem IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv, RingTheory/RegularLocalRing/Defs.lean:68-73.
